name: AcPrintPaperBin
description: Used with the PaperBin property to indicate which paper bin the specified printer should use.

constants.name: acPRBNUpper
constants.description: Use paper from the upper bin.

constants.name: acPRBNLower
constants.description: Use paper from the lower bin.

constants.name: acPRBNMiddle
constants.description: Use paper from the middle bin.

constants.name: acPRBNManual
constants.description: Wait for manual insertion of each sheet of paper.

constants.name: acPRBNEnvelope
constants.description: Use envelopes from the envelope feeder.

constants.name: acPRBNEnvManual
constants.description: Use envelopes from the envelope feeder, but wait for manual insertion.

constants.name: acPRBNAuto
constants.description: (Default) Use paper from the current default bin.

constants.name: acPRBNTractor
constants.description: Use paper from the tractor feeder.

constants.name: acPRBNSmallFmt
constants.description: Use paper from the small paper feeder.

constants.name: acPRBNLargeFmt
constants.description: Use paper from the large paper bin.

constants.name: acPRBNLargeCapacity
constants.description: Use paper from the large capacity feeder.

constants.name: acPRBNCassette
constants.description: Use paper from the attached cassette cartridge.

constants.name: acPRBNFormSource
constants.description: Use paper from the forms bin.
